ownership.quote: YepCode comes from years of building integrations for real clients. Our roots go back to Trileuco Solutions (founded in 2009), a software agency in Galicia (Spain) that grew to 50 engineers before being acquired.

stage.note: No press release, Crunchbase/PitchBook profile, or company statement disclosing any priced equity round was found (Crunchbase blocked access via Cloudflare; no TechCrunch/HN/LinkedIn funding coverage located). The Y Combinator company page for the 'yepcode' slug returns 404, so this is not a YC company. The 'About' page describes the founders' background at Trileuco Solutions, a Galician software agency (founded 2009, ~50 engineers, later acquired), suggesting the founders were experienced/self-funded operators, but no explicit 'bootstrapped'/self-funded statement or funding amount was found for YepCode itself, so stage is left unknown rather than guessed.

note: YepCode Run (serverless JS/Python execution sandboxes on Firecracker microVMs) is a product of YepCode, a Spanish (Galicia) company whose founders' prior venture, Trileuco Solutions, a software agency founded in 2009 that grew to ~50 engineers, was acquired. YepCode itself launched publicly via Show HN posts (YepCode Recipes, Aug 2022; YepCode Run, Feb 2025). No funding round, investor, accelerator participation, or revenue figures were found in company pages, HN, or search; Crunchbase and Bing search results were inaccessible (Cloudflare block / no indexable results) within the research time budget, so funding stage, amount, and revenue are left unknown rather than guessed.
